Package com.nutri_sci.service

Class ChartRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.nutri_sci.service.ChartRenderer
public class ChartRenderer extends Object
Service for rendering charts using configurable chart factories.

The ChartRenderer acts as a context in the Strategy pattern, allowing for dynamic selection of chart types at runtime. By accepting different chart factory implementations, this service can create various types of charts (pie, bar, line) from the same dataset without code duplication.

This design provides flexibility in chart creation and makes it easy to add new chart types or modify existing ones without affecting client code.

  • Method Details

    • setFactory

      public void setFactory(IChartFactory factory)
      Sets the chart factory to be used for chart creation.

      This method allows runtime configuration of the chart type by setting different factory implementations. The factory will be used for all subsequent calls to renderChart(Dataset) until changed.

      Parameters:
      factory - the chart factory to use for creating charts

    • renderChart

      public org.jfree.chart.JFreeChart renderChart(org.jfree.data.general.Dataset dataset)
      Renders a chart from the provided dataset using the configured factory.

      This method delegates chart creation to the currently set factory. The type of chart created depends on the factory implementation that was set via setFactory(IChartFactory).

      Parameters:
      dataset - the dataset containing the data to visualize
      Returns:
      a JFreeChart instance ready for display, or null if no factory is set or the dataset is null
